run_challenge_eval: run the challenge evaluation script with a results file and model name to compute ML prediction success rates
test_is_successful: test the is_successful function to check if a predicted energy is within threshold of the DFT energy
compute_valid_ml_success: compute validated ML success rates by comparing ML predicted energies against DFT ground truth energies
process_ml_data: process ML prediction results from an NPZ file and map energies to system and config IDs
get_dft_data: get organized DFT target data from a raw targets mapping for evaluation lookup
